posts.title: Introducing Our New Platform
posts.excerpt: We're excited to announce the launch of our redesigned platform with improved performance and new features.
posts.content:

### What's New

- **Faster Performance**: 50% improvement in load times
- **Redesigned Interface**: Cleaner, more intuitive navigation
- **New Features**: Enhanced collaboration tools

### Looking Ahead

This is just the beginning. We have an exciting roadmap planned for the coming months.

posts.title: Building for Scale: Lessons Learned
posts.excerpt: Key insights from scaling our infrastructure to handle millions of requests.
posts.content:
### The Challenge

Scaling isn't just about adding more servers. It requires rethinking architecture from the ground up.

### Key Lessons

1. **Start with observability** - You can't optimize what you can't measure
2. **Cache strategically** - Not everything needs to be cached
3. **Design for failure** - Assume things will break

### Results

These principles helped us achieve 99.99% uptime while handling 10x traffic growth.

posts.title: The Future of AI-Powered Development
posts.excerpt: Exploring how AI is transforming the way we build software.
posts.content:
### A Paradigm Shift

AI isn't replacing developers—it's augmenting their capabilities in unprecedented ways.

### Current Applications

- Code generation and completion
- Automated testing and debugging
- Documentation generation

### What's Next

The next wave will focus on AI understanding intent, not just syntax.
